headline: COP31 fails: Disagreements over fossil fuels prevent agreement
summary: The COP31 climate summit failed to reach an agreement after nearly two days of extended talks, which made it the longest COP on record. Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum, who presided over the talks, conceded.
why: UN climate conferences set the global framework for emissions targets and fossil fuel policy, which shapes long-term demand and regulatory expectations across the energy sector.
original_headline: Fracasa COP31: Discrepancias sobre combustibles fósiles impide acuerdo
